subject: Web Development
title: Babel and the Transpiler Age
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Babel and the Transpiler Age.

hook.text: ES6 features were amazing but browsers couldn't run them yet. What do you do?

buildup.text: Babel translated modern JavaScript into older syntax that every browser understood.

discovery.text: Write the future, ship the past. Developers used new features today and Babel handled the rest.

twist.text: Babel became a build step nobody questioned. JavaScript now required compilation like Java.

climax.text: Transpilers let the language evolve faster than browsers could implement features.

quiz.question: What does Babel do?
options: Converts modern JS to older syntax
